# Luxor Marbella

> Luxor Marbella is a property services and project management company in Marbella (Málaga, Spain): services for holiday and long-term rentals, project management of renovations and building works, renovations and home staging, and home maintenance and cleaning, for owners who do not live on the Costa del Sol all year round. One team and a single point of contact for the whole property.

- Website: https://www.luxormarbella.com/ (Spanish, with versions in English, French, German, Swedish and Russian)
- Phone and WhatsApp: +34 603 60 55 43
- Email: info@luxormarbella.com
- Areas served: Marbella, Puerto Banús, Nueva Andalucía, San Pedro de Alcántara, Benahavís, Estepona, Elviria, Las Chapas and Sotogrande.
- Fixed-price quotes: What you sign is what you pay.
- Our own team: No revolving door of subcontractors.
- Reply within 24 hours: On working days.
- A report after every visit: With photos, wherever you are.

## Services

- [Services for your rental property](https://www.luxormarbella.com/en/services/rentals/) (es: [Servicios para alquiler vacacional y de larga temporada en Marbella](https://www.luxormarbella.com/servicios/alquileres/)): Property services for rental homes in Marbella: listings on Airbnb and Idealista, check-ins and check-outs, changeover cleaning and guest support. Includes: Listings and bookings; Check-ins, check-outs and keys; Changeover cleaning and laundry; Guest and tenant support.
- [Project management for renovations and building works](https://www.luxormarbella.com/en/services/project-management/) (es: [Project management de reformas y obras en Marbella](https://www.luxormarbella.com/servicios/project-management/)): Project management for renovations and building works in Marbella: planning, fixed-price quotes, coordination of trades and suppliers, progress reports and handover. Includes: Planning and budget; Coordinating trades and suppliers; Site supervision; Quality control and handover.
- [Renovations, home staging and property improvements](https://www.luxormarbella.com/en/services/renovation-home-staging/) (es: [Reformas y home staging en Marbella](https://www.luxormarbella.com/servicios/reformas-home-staging/)): Full, partial and small renovations in Marbella, rental-ready refurbishment, furnishing, décor, home staging and post-renovation cleaning. Includes: Full and partial renovations; Rental-ready refurbishment; Furnishing, décor and home staging; Post-renovation cleaning.
- [Home maintenance, cleaning and premium services for owners](https://www.luxormarbella.com/en/services/maintenance-cleaning/) (es: [Mantenimiento y limpieza de viviendas en Marbella](https://www.luxormarbella.com/servicios/mantenimiento-limpieza/)): Preventive and reactive maintenance, cleaning, laundry, pool and outdoor areas, key holding and utilities management for homes in Marbella. Includes: Maintenance and repairs; Cleaning and laundry; Key holding and inspections; Utilities and services; Administration.
